subject: Warm intro and co-sell runway for Westbrook Health (AWS)
message_1:
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Emily Westbrook <emily@westbrookhealth.com>, Trevor Miles <trevor.miles@amazon.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: Westbrook Health — warm co-sell kickoff request

Hi Emily / Trevor —

Thanks again for the time on Tuesday. As discussed, Westbrook Health is evaluating a model inference strategy for clinical summarization and we think Redwood could be a strong fit for the workload. Trevor, would you be open to a short warm intro with Emily’s team to align on roles, a mutual action plan (MAP), and next steps for an AWS co-sell motion?

Suggested agenda (30 minutes):
- 5m intros and goals
- 10m high-level architecture + compliance constraints (Emily)
- 10m Redwood offering fit + what we need from AWS for co-sell
- 5m next steps + owner assignments

Emily — can you share the right stakeholders we should include (security, procurement, product) and two 30-minute slots next week that work? I’ll loop in Karthik and Laura from our side to lead the technical and commercial mapping. I’ve attached a short questionnaire & a draft MAP to accelerate procurement.

Thanks — looking forward to coordinating.

— Tessa Morgan
Director, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: westbrook-ma-plan-draft.xlsx (XLSX)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Emily Westbrook <emily@westbrookhealth.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@westbrookhealth.com>, procurement@westbrookhealth.com
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Trevor Miles <trevor.miles@amazon.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T08:57:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Westbrook Health — warm co-sell kickoff request

Hi Emily / Ravi / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick response and for flagging questions. Confirming Tue 4/20 at 10:00am PT works for us; copying Trevor so AWS can join.

What we’ll bring to the call (short, slide-first):
- Quick pricing framework: pilot hourly vs 3-month reserved pilot + example cost delta for typical batch-online mix
- MAP draft with milestones (PO, pilot start, security review, go/no-go) and owners
- Compliance artifacts overview: SOC 2 scope, data residency, KMS options and support model

Ravi — quick answers to help you prepare:
- SOC 2: Redwood Inference is scoping SOC 2 Type II across our control plane and hosted inference (we’ll share cert once final).
- Data residency: We offer regional deployments and can configure VPC/private deployments for PHI-sensitive workloads under an enterprise contract.
- KMS: Support for customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and HSM integrations possible for Private deployments.

I’ve attached a concise pricing sheet and a cleaned MAP; Tessa will send the annotated questionnaire to you Monday. If there are specific fields in the questionnaire you want prioritized, call them out and we’ll pre-fill on the call.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference
Attachment: westbrook-pricing-onepager.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: westbrook-ma-plan-draft-v2.xlsx (XLSX)
